title: Acts on tour: Billie Holiday and others
summary: Package acts included Billie Holiday, who liked Moore's playing, the Delta Rhythm Boys and Pigmeat Markham.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: Yes, I remember -- I should tell you some of the acts -- when we were on tour at the Oriole Theater in Baltimore and the Regal in Chicago, Apollo here and the TND Theater in Detroit, many of the
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

acts among us were the big name bracket, like Billie Holiday, she was with us for a while and then we had the Delta Rhythm Boys and the Two Zephyrs, I remember that act and also -- I can't think of the acts that were with us. We had Pigment Markham at one time at the Apollo with us, too. Most of the time we had Billie Holiday. I got to know Billie Holiday very, very well -- very close because she liked the way I blew my horn and she also was a great personality and usually closed the show and I can't think of who else was there.
Did she have you play with her sometimes? Did she ask you to come out and play with her?
